description:
installation of a 27.5 kWp rooftop solar PV system and a 14 kWh Battery Energy Storage System on two selected rooftops at Hornsey Vale Community Centre (N8 9LP). Once installed the system will cover a roof space amounting to approximately 423 m2. The site is a Haringey Council-owned site, leased to Hornsey Vale Community Association. 

The proposal envisages the installation of x60 465W Aiko PV modules, mounted on a series of non-intrusive Enstall FlatFix fusion flat-roof mounting systems. Additionally, a 14-kWh Fox EES battery, and a 20-kW Fox EES inverter will be installed on the property's external western wall. To ensure safe and secure access for rooftop installation, an appropriate scaffolding and roof access solution will be provided and overseen by the installer. Once installed, the rooftop solar PV equipment will be physically cabled and connected to the property's existing electrical metering point. All installation, cabling, testing and commissioning works will be undertaken by the MCS-accredited installer. 

No special access requirements, reconfiguration of existing street layouts, or permenant alterations to the property are required to conduct this installation.
site_name: Hornsey Vale Community Centre, 60 Mayfield Road, Hornsey, London, N8 9LP
